basics.name: Michael Roper
basics.label: Senior Web & Platforms Engineer
basics.summary: Michael is a senior web and platforms engineer with strong technical skills and over 20 years of experience designing, building, and operating high-performance websites for B2B technology and telecommunications brands. He specialises in modern Jamstack architectures (Astro, Next.js), design-system-driven frontends, and the integration of CMS, analytics, experimentation, and CI/CD pipelines to deliver fast, reliable, and measurable web experiences.

work.name: Uniti Group Limited
work.summary: Owner of multi-brand web platforms across Uniti's portfolio, leading architecture, implementation, and optimisation of modern web stacks.
highlights: Responsible for strategy and management of all customer-facing websites for multiple brands, including information architecture, UX, SEO, web performance and platform integration.
Led architecture and implementation of modern web stacks (Astro, Eleventy, Svelte, Tailwind, CloudCannon) deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
Implemented analytics, tracking and experimentation (GA/GA4, GTM, Hotjar, A/B testing) to support acquisition and conversion optimisation.
Implemented CI workflows using Bitbucket Pipelines and Cloudflare Pages previews to enable safe, reviewable changes across stakeholders.
Collaborated with marketing, product and sales stakeholders to deliver campaigns, landing pages and self-service customer journeys.

work.name: Vocus Communications
work.summary: Led development and operation of customer-facing web platforms and marketing technology for multiple telecommunications brands.
highlights: Responsible for strategy and management of customer-facing digital properties for multiple brands, including website builds, IA, UX, SEO, web performance and platform integration.
Led rebuild of Vocus.com.au as a decoupled CMS/front-end architecture (Next.js + Craft CMS on AWS/Heroku), improving stability, performance, organic CTR and bounce rate.
Management of marketing automation platforms (Marketo, Bizible and HubSpot) and integrations with CRM and other business systems.
Implemented full-funnel inbound acquisition and attribution workflows (AdWords/DoubleClick through to Marketo/Bizible and Salesforce) to enable multi-channel ROI reporting.
Stakeholder and agency management for key projects across marketing, product and sales.

work.name: Amcom Telecommunications
work.summary: Managed customer-facing web properties, marketing automation and digital campaigns.
highlights: Management of customer-facing websites for multiple brands, including design, development and content management.
Marketing automation using Marketo, including system structure, template creation, campaign build, reporting and integrations.
Optimised website architecture and assets in line with best practices for content and performance, achieving first-page Google rankings for key product keywords.
Digital advertising campaign management, including tracking and reporting across multiple channels.

work.name: Ajilon Australia
work.summary: Delivered web and interface design and development for government and enterprise clients.
highlights: Design and front-end development of websites, including eGov-compliant sites for state government clients.
Interface design for desktop and web applications.
Graphic design for bid collateral, annual reports, internal communications and training materials.
Creation of report and presentation templates for internal use.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Freelance web design and development for small business and organisational clients.
highlights: Design and development of various websites for different clients, including deployment of content management systems and custom PHP web applications.
Logo design and branding.
Client communication, training and support for CMS use.

work.name: Elixir Marketing Group
work.summary: Developed and maintained websites and web applications for agency clients.
highlights: Development and implementation of websites from supplied designs to HTML/CSS templates and CMS builds.
Development of PHP web applications, including research, planning, development, testing and support.
Design of website layouts, email newsletter templates and assistance with brand and product concepts.
Ongoing training and support for clients.

work.name: Worldwide Online Printing
work.summary: Managed internal web applications and public web presence for a national printing franchise.
highlights: Interface design and development of a network-wide quoting/CRM application.
Design and development of company intranet.
Maintenance and updates for the public website.
Managing online print management sites for franchises and their clients.
